name: NSW Gas Rebate
summary: Daily credit on your natural gas bill for NSW households holding a Health Care Card or other eligible concession card.
who: Live in NSW at your principal place of residence
Hold a Pensioner Concession Card, Health Care Card, Low Income Health Care Card or DVA Veteran Gold Card
how: Ask for the NSW Gas Rebate to be applied to your account.
catches: One NSW Gas Rebate per household per financial year; the page does not state the amount.

source.label: Service NSW: Apply for the Gas Rebate (retail customers)

evidence.quote: You can only receive the rebate for your principal place of residence.
